references.name: William O’Neil
references.desc: How to Make Money in Stocks; founder of IBD
references.connection:
Creator of CAN SLIM formula; Cohen cites it as one of
    the finest stock-screening approaches for finding
    high-quality call candidates

references.name: Benjamin Graham
references.connection:
“Mr. Market” metaphor used throughout
    to explain market sentiment as separable from
    intrinsic value

references.name: Warren Buffett
references.connection:
Forecasting quote; common-sense investing approach
    (notice products becoming ubiquitous)

references.name: Jack Schwager
references.connection:
Cited for evidence that top traders use NLP and hypnosis
    to enhance performance; validates Cohen’s psychology-first
    approach

references.name: Charles Mackay
references.desc:
Extraordinary Popular Delusions and the Madness
    of Crowds (1841/1980)
references.connection:
Historical precedent for crowd manias; used in the
    fundamental analysis chapter to warn against following
    consensus sentiment

references.name: J. Welles Wilder
references.connection:
RSI described as the most interpretable oscillator;
    Cohen prefers it to stochastics and MACD

references.name: Gerald Appel
references.connection:
MACD covered as a widely known indicator; Cohen finds it
    highly subjective and does not use it himself

references.name: Fischer Black and Myron Scholes
W.D. Gann
references.desc: Gann levels; first trader to use Fibonacci ratios
references.connection:
Cohen acknowledges Gann’s historical contribution
    but describes personal results as “hit-and-miss”

references.name: Peter Lynch
references.desc:
One Up on Wall Street; former Fidelity Magellan
    manager
references.connection:
Common-sense investing: notice ubiquitous products,
    research who makes them, invest before the market
    discovers them

references.name: Prof. Gordon Gemmill
references.desc: City University (Cass) Business School; options lecturer
references.connection:
Cohen’s MBA professor; academic knowledge was necessary
    but insufficient for actual trading success

references.name: Alpesh Patel
references.desc: Trading Online; Mind of a Trader
references.connection:
Introduced Cohen to Financial Times/Pearson publishing;
    colleague and co-endorser
